title: PepSpecBench: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for Peptide Tandem Mass Spectrometry Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2605.01945v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tandem mass spectrometry provides a high-throughput framework for identifying and quantifying proteins in complex biological samples. In computational proteomics, predicting peptide MS/MS spectra is a critical task, enabling downstream applications such as large-scale peptide identification and quantification. While deep learning architectures have substantially improved prediction accuracy, three evaluation challenges obscure the true progress of the field. First, inconsistent data preprocessing and incompatible model output spaces hinder fair model comparison. Second, flawed data splitting strategies can permit hidden sequence leakage and inflate reported performance. Third, existing evaluations typically lack systematic assessment of heterogeneous zero-shot domain shift and robustness to collision energy and precursor charge. To address these challenges, we propose PepSpecBench, a unified benchmark for peptide MS/MS spectrum

translated_title: PepSpecBench：肽段串联质谱预测的统一评估基准
translated_abstract: 串联质谱为复杂生物样品中蛋白质的鉴定与定量提供了高通量框架。在计算蛋白质组学中，预测肽段的MS/MS（二级质谱）谱图是一项关键任务，它支撑着大规模肽段鉴定与定量等下游应用。尽管深度学习架构已显著提升了预测准确度，但三个评估方面的挑战掩盖了该领域的真实进展。第一，不一致的数据预处理和互不兼容的模型输出空间阻碍了模型间的公平比较。第二，有缺陷的数据划分策略可能导致隐藏的序列泄露，从而虚增所报告的性能。第三，现有评估通常缺乏对异构零样本域偏移以及对碰撞能量和前体电荷鲁棒性的系统性评估。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PepSpecBench，一个用于肽段MS/MS谱图预测的统一基准。
tldr: 提出了PepSpecBench——一个肽段串联质谱谱图预测的统一评估基准，通过统一的数据预处理与输出空间、防止序列泄露的数据划分策略以及对域偏移和碰撞能量、前体电荷鲁棒性的系统评估，解决了该领域模型无法公平比较的三大挑战。
